title: Code for: A third of the world's threatened land vertebrates exposed to tropical urbanization
description:
Code for the paper "A third of the world's threatened land vertebrates exposed to tropical urbanization", which delineates 7,229 tropical urban agglomerations from 30 m impervious-surface dynamics and measures the expert-mapped range of threatened and range-restricted land vertebrates that their expansion converted between 2000 and 2020. The deposit holds the Python code of the measurement and the analysis, the scripts that draw the figures of the paper and its Supplementary Information with the figures they draw, and the instructions for obtaining the source data.

The deposit does not redistribute the source data (GISD30, GLC_FCS30D, IUCN Red List spatial data, BirdLife International bird distribution maps, Natural Earth and RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017), which are available from their providers under their own terms. README.md gives the source and the expected location of each product.
